summary: Remove the three resemble stems copied from šbh into šbḥ
rationale: The complete I, II~2 and III blocks use h, mean resemble, and reproduce the corresponding šbh forms, senses and all ten examples, including 3/9, 25/12, 26/163, 35/47, 74/54, 24/153–154, 29/334 and 84/35. The šbḥ head and the remaining stems describe praise with ḥ. Remove only the copied resemble blocks; retain the praise material.

summary: Move mšabaḥḥe from Infectum to Preterit
rationale: mšabaḥḥe is the plural-agent preterit corresponding to the listed base mšabaḥle, with the l-suffix assimilated to ḥ. It is not the Infectum mšabaḥ with personal endings; the supplied translation also says They praised God. Preserve NE_254;14.

summary: Consolidate the two identical stem-II praise records
rationale: The same head, stem II, forms mšabaḥle/mšabaḥ and praise/glorify sense occur twice. The first copy has no examples; the second has the NE_254;14 example. glossary_lookup.py entry šbḥ also displays these as two separate records with the same head. Consolidate the duplicate praise records without deleting the populated example or stem III.
